knowledge-base.overview: Sinatra 3.x guardrails, modular application patterns, routing DSL, helpers, middleware, error handling, and testing. Applies to microservices, REST APIs, webhooks, and lightweight Ruby web applications. Use modular style (Sinatra::Base subclass) for all production apps; classic style only for scripts and prototypes.

core-principles.principle: Subclass Sinatra::Base rather than using classic top-level DSL. Modular style isolates settings, prevents global state contamination, and supports multiple apps in one process.
Routes are HTTP dispatch — nothing more. Business logic belongs in service objects under app/services/ with no Sinatra imports.
Always run behind Puma. Never use the default WEBrick server in production.
All secrets and environment-specific config come from environment variables loaded by dotenv. Never hardcode credentials.
Authentication, CORS, rate limiting, and logging are Rack middleware — not inline route logic.

guardrail.rule: Never hardcode secrets. Load all secrets and DSN strings from ENV via dotenv. Raise in production if a required secret is absent.
Use parameterized queries via ActiveRecord or Sequel. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings.
Use classic style only for scripts and prototypes. All production applications must use Sinatra::Base subclasses.
guardrail.bad: # app.rb — classic style in production get '/' do "Hello World" end
guardrail.good: class App < Sinatra::Base get '/' do 'Hello World' end end

guardrail.rule: Implement authentication checks in before filters scoped to path prefixes, not duplicated per route.
Configure CORS restrictively. Never use wildcard (*) origins in production.
Always halt with a status code and a JSON body on error. Never let exceptions bubble to the default Sinatra error page in production.
guardrail.good: error ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound do status 404 json error: 'Resource not found' end

guardrail.rule: Parse JSON request bodies through a helper that rescues JSON::ParserError and halts 400. Never call JSON.parse directly in route blocks.
guardrail.good: def json_params @json_params ||= begin body = request.body.read body.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(body, symbolize_names: true) rescue JSON::ParserError halt 400, json(error: 'Invalid JSON') end end

guardrail.rule: Use sinatra-contrib extensions (sinatra/json, sinatra/namespace, sinatra/reloader) rather than reimplementing them.
Disable show_exceptions in production to avoid leaking stack traces to clients.

project-structure.example: myapp/ ├── config.ru # Rack entry point ├── Gemfile ├── Rakefile # Database tasks ├── app/ │ ├── main.rb # Sinatra::Base application class │ ├── routes/ # Route modules — one per resource │ │ ├── auth.rb │ │ ├── users.rb │ │ └── posts.rb │ ├── models/ # ActiveRecord / Sequel models │ │ ├── user.rb │ │ └── post.rb │ ├── services/ # Business logic — no Sinatra imports │ │ └── user_service.rb │ └── helpers/ # Reusable helper modules │ ├── auth_helper.rb │ └── response_helper.rb ├── config/ │ ├── database.yml │ └── environment.rb # Boot: dotenv, bundler, DB setup ├── db/ │ └── migrations/ ├── public/ ├── views/ └── spec/ ├── spec_helper.rb ├── routes/ └── models/

pattern.name: Application Class
pattern.description: Wire helpers, routes, error handlers, and configuration in one Sinatra::Base subclass.
pattern.example:
# app/main.rb require 'sinatra/base' require 'sinatra/json' require 'sinatra/namespace'
class App < Sinatra::Base register Sinatra::Namespace
configure do set :server, :puma set :root, File.dirname(__FILE__) set :views, proc { File.join(root, '..', 'views') } enable :sessions set :session_secret, ENV.fetch('SESSION_SECRET') end
configure :development do require 'sinatra/reloader' register Sinatra::Reloader enable :logging end
configure :production do disable :show_exceptions enable :raise_errors end
# Auto-load helpers and routes Dir[File.join(__dir__, 'helpers', '*.rb')].each { |f| require f } helpers AuthHelper, ResponseHelper
Dir[File.join(__dir__, 'routes', '*.rb')].each { |f| require f } register Routes::Users register Routes::Auth
get('/health') { json status: 'ok', timestamp: Time.now.iso8601 } not_found { json error: 'Not found' } error { json error: 'Internal server error' } end

pattern.name: Route Module
pattern.description: One module per resource. Register via self.registered(app) and use Sinatra::Namespace for path grouping.
pattern.example:
# app/routes/users.rb module Routes module Users def self.registered(app) app.namespace '/api/v1/users' do get { json users: User.all.map(&:to_h) } get '/:id' do json user: User.find(params[:id]).to_h end
post do user = User.create!(json_params) status 201 json user: user.to_h rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e status 422 json errors: e.record.errors.full_messages end
put '/:id' do user = User.find(params[:id]) user.update!(json_params) json user: user.to_h rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e status 422 json errors: e.record.errors.full_messages end
delete '/:id' do User.find(params[:id]).destroy status 204 end end end end end

pattern.name: Auth and Response Helpers
pattern.example:
# app/helpers/auth_helper.rb module AuthHelper def current_user @current_user ||= User.find_by(id: session[:user_id]) if session[:user_id] end
def require_login! halt 401, json(error: 'Unauthorized') unless current_user end
def require_admin! require_login! halt 403, json(error: 'Forbidden') unless current_user.admin? end
def authenticate_token! token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub('Bearer ', '') halt 401, json(error: 'Missing token') unless token payload = JWT.decode(token, ENV.fetch('JWT_SECRET'), true, algorithm: 'HS256').first @current_user = User.find_by(id: payload['user_id']) halt 401, json(error: 'Invalid token') unless @current_user rescue JWT::DecodeError halt 401, json(error: 'Invalid token') end end
# app/helpers/response_helper.rb module ResponseHelper def paginate(collection, per_page: 20) page = (params[:page] || 1).to_i per = (params[:per_page] || per_page).to_i.clamp(1, 100) total = collection.count items = collection.offset((page - 1) * per).limit(per) { items: items, meta: { page: page, per_page: per, total: total } } end end

pattern.name: Error Handlers
pattern.example:
# In App class — catches exceptions globally error ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound do status 404 json error: 'Resource not found' end
error ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid do |e| status 422 json errors: e.record.errors.full_messages end
error JSON::ParserError do status 400 json error: 'Invalid JSON' end
not_found { json error: 'Not found' } error { json error: 'Internal server error' }

pattern.name: Rack Entry Point
pattern.example: # config.ru require 'bundler/setup' Bundler.require(:default, ENV.fetch('RACK_ENV', 'development')) require_relative 'config/environment' require_relative 'app/main' run App

pattern.name: RSpec Route Test
pattern.example:
# spec/routes/users_spec.rb require 'spec_helper'
RSpec.describe 'Users API' do include Rack::Test::Methods
def app = App
let!(:user) { create(:user) }
describe 'GET /api/v1/users' do it 'returns 200 with user list' do get '/api/v1/users' expect(last_response.status).to eq(200) body = JSON.parse(last_response.body) expect(body['users']).to be_an(Array) end end
describe 'POST /api/v1/users' do it 'creates a user and returns 201' do post '/api/v1/users', { email: 'new@example.com', name: 'New User', password: 'secret' }.to_json, 'CONTENT_TYPE' => 'application/json' expect(last_response.status).to eq(201) end
it 'returns 422 for missing fields' do post '/api/v1/users', {}.to_json, 'CONTENT_TYPE' => 'application/json' expect(last_response.status).to eq(422) end end end

dep.purpose: HTTP request helpers for Rack apps

quick-reference.item: Sinatra::Base subclass — never classic style in production
One module per resource, registered via self.registered(app)
AuthHelper, ResponseHelper — included via helpers DSL
json_params helper wrapping JSON.parse with rescue halt 400
halt 401/403/404/422 with json body — stops execution immediately
before '/api/*' do ... end for scoped cross-cutting logic
error ExceptionClass do ... end — never leak stack traces
ENV.fetch('KEY') — raises KeyError if missing, not silent nil
Rack::Test::Methods + def app = App; test success + error paths
Restrictive configuration via Rack middleware — never wildcard in production
